captions.detailed: A simple, clean 3D ring band with a flat outer face and cylindrical inner and outer walls. It is rendered in a solid gray plastic finish, featuring a consistent thickness and width throughout its circumference. The design is optimized for custom engraving on both the internal and external cylindrical surfaces.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric ring design in OpenSCAD that allows customization of the ring's US size, thickness, and width. Integrate the 'write/Write.scad' library to enable custom text engravings on both the outer and inner cylindrical walls with adjustable font styles, sizes, and spacing.
captions.factory: The code uses a difference() operation to subtract the inner volume and text engravings from an outer cylinder. It starts with a main cylinder representing the outer radius (inner_radius + ring_thickness) and height (ring_width). Inside a nested difference block, it uses the 'writecylinder' module from the 'write' library to engrave text on the outer surface, and a mirrored 'writecylinder' to engrave readable text on the inner surface. Finally, a central cylinder of radius 'inner_radius' is subtracted to hollow out the ring.
